title: When fear hardens into anger
subtitle: For the body that attacks because it feels unsafe
description: Start with the Merciful Creator who nourishes what He creates. These readings cool anxiety before it recruits anger as armor.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The shabad asks why the mortal wavers when the Merciful One already creates, gives, cherishes, and protects.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When fear tightens into attack, remember mercy before your mouth turns protection into harm.

evidence.coreClaim: This path treats anger as fear that forgot the Creator’s care.
evidence.turn: Anxiety softens before it becomes anger when mercy is named as the first reality in the room.
evidence.practicalImplication: Soothe the frightened body first; answer the situation only after the chest has stopped bracing.
